definitions.explanation: An informal, affectionate term for one's grandfather. Used by children and within families.
Used informally to refer to an elderly man in general, not necessarily one's own grandfather.

examples.japanese: おじいちゃん、⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧！

examples.english: I'm going to visit grandpa's house.

examples.japanese: おじいちゃん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: Grandpa likes to tell stories about the old days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おじいちゃん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけて→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧きた。
examples.english: An old man at the park started talking to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧おじいちゃん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧だ。
examples.english: The old man next door is very energetic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧おじいちゃん⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っていた→迷う：02426_mayou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{案内|あんない}して→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: An elderly man was lost in front of the station, so I helped him find his way.

notes:
The affectionate, informal form of ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ (grandfather) or ⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧. The ちゃん suffix makes it warmer and more childlike than ⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧.

FORMALITY SCALE:
- ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ — formal/written; used when referring to one's own grandfather in formal contexts
- ⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧ — polite; used for someone else's grandfather or an elderly man
- おじいちゃん — informal/affectionate; used within the family or for a familiar elderly man
- じいちゃん — very informal; casual, often used by boys and men

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧ — grandmother; grandma; old woman (the female equivalent)
- ⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧ — grandfather; old man (polite form)
- ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ — grandfather (formal)
- ⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧ — elderly person (neutral/formal)

USAGE:
When referring to your own grandfather to outsiders, use ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧ in formal situations. When speaking to or about someone else's grandfather, use ⟦おじいさん→おじいさん：02860_ojiisan⟧ or おじいさま. おじいちゃん is for family use or when speaking affectionately. Calling an unknown elderly man おじいちゃん can sound either friendly or condescending depending on context.
